transition_between_scenes.name: warm_flash
transition_between_scenes.envelope_frames: 9 flash frames, screen-blended colours in assets/transitions/warm_flash.json: yellow (255,199,60) for frames 1-3, shifting to red (238,66,54) by frame 5, then dark red (139,19,27) fading out
transition_between_scenes.content_swap: frame 6 after the flash starts for scene 1 to 2, frame 4 for scene 2 to 3 (the swap is hidden under the flash)
transition_between_scenes.audio: no whoosh; scene-boundary audio dips to near silence (0.05-0.2 s)
transition_between_scenes.implementation: BUILT: assets/transitions/warm_flash.json (screen-blend colours per frame), applied by scripts/render.py as lutrgb filters over a hard cut. Uniform colour per frame, so the reference's slight colour gradient across the frame is not reproduced.

timing.scene_boundary: transition starts as the last line of the scene ends (+/-0.05 s); next scene's first line starts 0.1-0.5 s after the transition ends
timing.measured_with: wav2vec2 base 95M with energy start snap and end extension

audio.sfx: calibrated post-loudnorm SFX (-4 to 0 dB for # SFX:, +1.0 dB wrong / +0.5 dB right for # MARKS:; sn_riser_1.wav for risers); laughter (voice) 15.0-19.5 s in reference
audio.note: normalise dialogue to Zeno's -11.5 LUFS (-1.0 dBTP cap), mixing peak-calibrated SFX post-loudnorm
